id.description: Quant Agent monitor id from quant_agent_list_monitors

notifyPush.description: Send each fire as a web push

notifyWebhookUrl.description: https:// webhook to POST each fire to. Must be https — http is rejected by the route. Empty string clears it.

enabled.description: false pauses the monitor without deleting it

fireRule.description: always = notify on every signal (default). on_change = notify only when the call differs from the last one that fired, so a repeated SELL stays quiet.

idempotencyKey.description: REQUIRED. A stable caller-chosen key (max 120 chars) that makes this call safe to retry — repeat the SAME key to retry, and the first result is replayed instead of a second write. Omitting it is refused, not defaulted. Scope: this MCP session's process (the web routes do not yet honour x-idempotency-key), so it protects a retried tool call, not a cross-process replay.
